think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range. 2) Check PostgreSQL documentation/source comments for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/enable a different mode) rather than just scaling behavior. 3) Determine whether any such sentinel value breaks the natural numeric ordering by switching the feature off/on or changing interpretation. 4) If a sentinel exists, mark as special and record the value; otherwise mark as not special.
